cause: The boundary initially trusted permissive normalization, caller-supplied representations, and plain-text section matching instead of exact types, canonical identity, a bounded stable snapshot, installed-code provenance, and downstream rendered semantics.
prevention: Security and authorization gates must bind exact typed canonical inputs and installed code, union supplied evidence with registered risk, and validate the grammar and rendered semantics actually consumed; every remediation receives adjacent-state adversarial probes.
summary: Seven independent W4b rounds found adjacent ways for caller-controlled values, substituted snapshots, malformed metadata, missing gates, or non-rendered Markdown headings to satisfy a boundary whose local examples were already green.
title: Authorization boundary accepted normalized or non-rendered representations
